engineBaseline: flat 80 OVR: slotWins(s, ovr) is measured with all other slots at 80, so the engine's implicit replacement level is an 80-OVR player at every slot — NOT a position-specific replacement level.

slots.basis: 5th-ranked DL rotation share 0.33 (mean), median 35%, middle half 22%-44%, stable 2023-2025 (dl5-snaps.py, nflverse snap_counts, 1632 team-games, REG). Engine weight 91..184 across the 22%-44% share band. Replacement = 4th DL rotated off ~67% of snaps. Who DL5 replaces while on field (uniform over DE1/DE2/DT1/DT2) is INFERRED.

13 personnel (1RB 3TE 1WR) = 4.40% of plays (personnel-shares.py, nflverse participation 96,624 plays 2023-25); installRecv bakes 4.52% share from WR2 into TE3. Depth-snap split TE2 vs TE3 not yet measured — UNKNOWN component.
